analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy signal, RSI moved from 34.9 to 38.1, exiting oversold territory, and MACD histogram improved to -2.7561. However, the price remains below SMA200 (-6.58%) and EMA50 (-9.58%), indicating continued downward pressure on medium-to-long term trends. ADX is at 26.9, showing a clear trend, but -DI (37.9) is stronger than +DI (14.2). Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach rather than switching to a buy.
